outcome_values_inspected_before_freeze: none; no predictions, contrasts, target distribution statistics, or metric values were computed or inspected before freeze
claim: Bounded singleton diagnostic on 2024-06 (train 2024-04-25..2024-05-24, test 2024-06-01..2024-06-30, 7-day embargo) to attribute estimator-vs-data sensitivity under the frozen B0/B1/C1/C2 and C2-vs-B1 24h QLIKE contract. This is a singleton diagnostic only, never a fresh three-block confirmation, and all outputs are EXPLORATORY_ONLY with promotable=false.

splits.design: single disjoint 30-day test block with 30-day train and 7-day embargo
splits.notes: Feature construction and targets are built on a grid extending to target_forward_buffer_end so 24h forward targets exist through 2024-06-30; test evaluation rows are restricted to 2024-06-01..2024-06-30 and all features remain strictly causal at origin t.

sealed.name: sealed
sealed.description: Raw features, no scaling/standardization, no train-only smearing, finite-row masking only; OLS on log(target+eps) with plain exp back-transform.
sealed.fit: OLS normal equations with small ridge diagonal for numerical stability (1e-12)

corrected.name: corrected
corrected.description: Train-only standardization, finite-row masking, train-only Duan smearing on log-target residuals, explicit drop-only missingness.
corrected.missingness: drop rows with non-finite required features/target; never fill/impute
corrected.fit: OLS least squares on standardized design

bootstrap.method: paired day-block bootstrap over UTC days in test set

holm.family: primary and secondary contrasts within this singleton diagnostic

loio.rule: leave one instrument out of training, evaluate held-out instrument on the 2024-06 test block; report count with rel_reduction>=2% and ci_excludes_zero_improving

placebo.method: permute signed_funding and abs_fund_pct within symbol in train/test panel construction context for refit/eval
placebo.rule: true relative reduction must exceed null 95th percentile

verdict_rule.EXPLAINED_BY_ESTIMATOR: material change in primary C2-vs-B1 direction/magnitude attributable to estimator arm (sealed vs corrected) under lineage-consistent panel and passing leakage/coverage checks
verdict_rule.EXPLAINED_BY_DATA: lineage/data-coverage/audit evidence explains outcome under estimator-consistent behavior
verdict_rule.UNEXPLAINED: neither estimator nor lineage/data audit explains the outcome; bounded exploratory attribution remains unresolved
verdict_rule.INCONCLUSIVE: any required prereg/lineage/coverage/hash/key/leakage mismatch or missing required artifact prevents numeric attribution

forbidden: running a fresh three-block confirmation on 2024-06
inspecting predictions/contrasts/target summaries/metric values/outcome distributions before prereg freeze
network fetches, paid/credentialed/manual data, raw cache commits, workflow edits
relabeling exploratory as confirmatory or promoting H1
